input.subject: Your report about Flat 12 – Flat 11, 40 Crown Parade (ref R/10)
input.body:
Dear Tenant,

Thank you for your email about Flat 11, 40 Crown Parade, Westhollow, ZZ9 5ZZ (ref R/10). I'm sorry you have been losing sleep.

Noise and antisocial behaviour from a neighbouring flat isn't something a maintenance contractor can resolve, so I have passed your report to a member of our team who handles neighbour and antisocial-behaviour matters. They will be in touch with you about next steps.

In the meantime:
- If you ever feel in immediate danger or see a crime in progress, call 999.
- To report suspected drug dealing or other non-emergency crime, call the police on 101, or report anonymously to Crimestoppers on 0800 555 111.
- Late-night noise can also be reported to your local council's environmental health / noise team.
- It may help to keep a short diary of dates, times and what happened.

If anything at the property itself is damaged or not secure (for example a communal door that won't lock), please let us know straight away so we can deal with it as a repair.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Operations
